title: JJK – Central 47 Database Terminal
description: Jujutsu Sorcery Commission classified network terminal. Opens from the Journal sidebar — available to all players and the GM for in-session roleplay access.
description-changes: v3.0.3 — Stale-terminal watchdog. On top of v3.0.2's version-busted asset URL and handshake retries: if an opened terminal never performs the sync handshake (the signature of an old cached copy), the module force-reloads it fresh once, and if it is still silent it shows an on-screen error naming the real problem (outdated server files) instead of failing quietly.
